experiments.title: Source-aware reward-scale and hypervolume-reference calibration
experiments.notes: V1 failed closed on sparse Minecart returns. Source-aware v2 then passed using an independent fixed-pool LunarLander pilot and a deterministic versioned Minecart environment reference front. Both course protocols now contain frozen scales/reference points with hashed evidence; no final-test data was accessed.

experiments.title: Paired-seed controls and allocation-signal ablations
experiments.notes: Frozen as 150 paired jobs across two environments and five seeds. The 30-job primary PCQN block completed and its source audit passed. Validation re-evaluation preserved raw and discounted returns for all 300 saved checkpoints, but failed closed because all 15 Minecart runs had zero variation in ore objectives 0 and 1. The checkpoint lock is blocked with zero locks; the remaining 120 jobs and final test remain prohibited, and no comparative claim has been promoted.
